PPO treatments vs Custom Product Pages — two different tools

Teams conflate Apple's two product-page experiment surfaces. They share some field names but serve different traffic and live at different URLs.

Product Page Optimization (PPO)

Built into the default product page in App Store Connect. You define a control and up to three treatment variants with alternate subtitle, promotional text, and screenshot sets. Apple splits organic App Store traffic between variants and reports impression and conversion metrics. The URL stays your standard product page — no campaign deep link.

  • Traffic source: organic browse and Search on each storefront where the test runs
  • Per-locale: each treatment needs its own zh-Hans subtitle, promotional text, and screenshot captions if you want localized variants on the China storefront
  • You configure the test; Apple assigns visitors — we do not run or analyze it

Custom Product Pages (CPP)

Separate page variants with unique URLs for paid user acquisition, influencer codes, email campaigns, or Apple Search Ads deep links. Up to 35 per app. Localizing PPO treatment copy does not localize CPPs, and vice versa. See CPP localization guide.

This page covers zh-Hans copy for PPO treatment fields only — not CPP campaign pages, not default listing fields outside an active test, and not Apple Search Ads bid management. For ASA landing-page mismatch, see Apple Search Ads in China.

Why China storefront PPO often stays on the English control

Connect treats PPO localization the same way as the default listing matrix: each treatment variant has independent rows per language. Common failure modes:

  • Treatments built en-US only — Treatment B subtitle and promo text exist in English; zh-Hans row is empty, so China traffic falls back to control copy
  • Assuming default zh-Hans listing propagates into treatments — your main listing row is localized, but PPO treatment B carries its own fields that do not inherit from default or from other treatments
  • Localized screenshot art, English caption strings — design exported Chinese overlay frames but Connect caption metadata for treatment B is still Latin script
  • One treatment localized, siblings forgotten — Treatment B has zh-Hans; Treatments C and D do not, yet all run on the China storefront
  • Attributing low China conversion to audience fit — the experiment never showed a Chinese variant; the control was the only option zh-Hans visitors could see

Filling zh-Hans treatment fields gives China-assigned traffic a fair comparison against your English control — it does not guarantee win rates, impression share, or ranking movement.

FAQ

What is Product Page Optimization (PPO) vs Custom Product Pages (CPP)?

Product Page Optimization is Apple's built-in A/B testing on your default product page — you create treatment variants with alternate subtitle, promotional text, and screenshots, and Apple splits organic traffic between control and treatments. Custom Product Pages are separate campaign URLs with their own deep links for paid ads or influencer codes. PPO treatments live on the default page URL; CPPs are distinct URLs. Localizing one does not localize the other.

Why does my zh-Hans PPO test still show English copy?

PPO treatment fields are localized per locale in App Store Connect. If you built treatments in en-US only, zh-Hans storefront visitors see the English control or empty fallback — not your US treatment copy. Each treatment variant needs its own zh-Hans subtitle, promotional text, and screenshot caption strings if you want Chinese buyers to see a localized variant.

What do I send after AppLocale payment?

Your live App Store listing URL, which PPO treatment variant you want localized (Control, Treatment B, C, or D), current English treatment subtitle, promotional text, and screenshot caption lines, target locale (zh-Hans), and any deadline. Reply from the email address on your Stripe receipt — we deliver to that Stripe email within 24 hours.

Does AppLocale run my Product Page Optimization test?

No. You create treatments, set traffic allocation, and read results in App Store Connect. We deliver copy files only — we do not log into your account, start experiments, or interpret conversion data.

Can you localize all three treatments in one order?

The base $79 deliverable covers one treatment variant's zh-Hans copy fields. If you need multiple treatments localized, note that in intake — we can scope additional variants separately.

Will zh-Hans treatment copy improve my PPO win rate in China?

We do not guarantee conversion lift or statistical significance. Complete zh-Hans treatment copy lets China-assigned traffic see a localized variant instead of English-only control — it is not a placement or algorithm hack.
